ai.seo_question: How does fulfilling social obligations preserve divine blessings according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this maxim from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (AS) establishes the principle of *shukr* (gratitude) as a mechanism for the preservation of divine favors, linking material abundance to social obligation. Scholarly tradition interprets this as a warning against the stagnation of blessings (*zawal*) when the wealthy fail to discharge their religious and social duties, thereby transforming static wealth into dynamic, enduring stability.
